original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Construct a single spectator-only scalar basis restriction taking any normalized simple-label S4 m-call word with active endpoint width w and crossing rank L to at most w+m-L roles, preserving every paid factor and full formal endpoint.
scope_change_reason: PR4765 handles only zero inversion slack. This task changes that premise to positive slack and arbitrary active formal endpoints, supplying a quantitative role bound without rerunning the fixed mixed-target exclusion.
bottleneck_link: At a fixed excess-call budget the new theorem bounds all possible dirty workspace in this formal alphabet. It does not provide a saving word, native implementation or complete supplier bill.
stop_rule: Stop after the local defect charge, nested spectator splitting, one global formal intertwiner and bounded independent exact controls; if the bound fails retain a concrete counterexample. No finite S4 exclusion replay or new target census.
evidence: Written quantitative proof with preserved-factor sharpness; 2419200 exact local peel controls, 341 split cases and eight constructive full formal fixtures. Separate faithful regular-action code checks 4968 factor columns and 1440 full-word columns. Seven semantic groups and eight optimized-CLI corruption controls reject invalid evidence.
author: JoyboyBrian
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, implementation and verification, including separate coordinating-agent proof review. Distinct implementations are not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.

family_decision: Narrow to positive-slack workspace compression. A proof removes unbounded role search at fixed call excess; it does not admit a physical supplier. Stop after the reduction and its controls; reopen for non-simple labels, non-restored endpoints or a concrete application whose complete costs are specified.

overlap.limits: Offline snapshots; arbitrary diffs, unretained closed work and unpublished work not searched.
